name: parallel-streams
goal: Ship three independent streams for our web app: one worker for the frontend shell (task mentions frontend), one for the backend API (task mentions backend), one for the docs site (task mentions docs). Project decisions you already know: auth is session cookies (we standardized on that last quarter), and workers may install docs tooling if they ask. Dispatch ALL THREE jobs before supervising any of them — do not run them one at a time. Then supervise: answer questions, approve provisioning requests, and wait until all three are done. Acknowledge all three jobs, then write a one-line rollup per stream.

quiz.ask: From memory, without running any more commands: for each of the three jobs, state its final state and whether it needed anything from you mid-run (a question or an approval) — and if so, what you answered or approved.
